```yaml
name: Claude Code

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: 'Issue number to fix'
        required: true
        type: string
      instructions:
        description: 'Optional instructions for Claude Code'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

jobs:
  claude:
    name: Run Claude Code
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    concurrency:
      group: claude-${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: read
      actions: read
    env:
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install GitHub CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Verify collaborator permission
        id: check_collaborator
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          status=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/collaborators/${{ github.actor }})
          if [ "$status" -eq 204 ]; then
            echo "is_collaborator=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "is_collaborator=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Error: ${{ github.actor }} is not a collaborator." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Get issue details
        id: get_issue
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          issue_json=$(curl -s \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }})
          author=$(echo "$issue_json" | jq -r '.user.login')
          body=$(echo "$issue_json" | jq -r '.body')
          echo "author=$author" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf '%s' "$body" > issue.txt

      - name: Run Claude Code
        id: run_claude
        shell: bash
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npx claude-code --issue-file issue.txt --instructions "${{ github.event.inputs.instructions }}"

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check_changes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "No changes made by Claude Code."
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Changes detected."
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -b claude-code/issue-${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}
          git add -A
          git commit -m "Claude Code fix for #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}"
          git push origin HEAD

      - name: Create draft PR
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh pr create --draft \
            --title "Claude Code fix for #${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number }}" \
            --body "Automated fix by Claude Code" \
            --assignee @${{ steps.get_issue.outputs.author }}
```
